title: Walking in Obedience
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Walking in obedience means responding to God’s Word with faithful action. Believers obey not to earn salvation, but because they love Christ, belong to Him, and desire to honor Him.
summary: Walking in obedience means responding to God’s Word with faithful action. Believers obey not to earn salvation, but because they love Christ, belong to Him, and desire to honor Him.
christFocus: Jesus Christ perfectly obeyed the Father and calls His people to follow Him. His grace forgives disobedience, and His lordship teaches believers to walk in His commands.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Obedience is the proper response to God’s Word. Scripture is not given merely to be heard, studied, or discussed. It calls for faith-filled action before the Lord.

Christian obedience is rooted in love, not self-salvation. Jesus says, “If you love me, keep my commandments.” The believer obeys because grace has brought him under the loving authority of Christ.

Obedience also reveals the difference between a life built on rock and a life built on sand. Hearing without obedience is spiritual danger. God’s Word is meant to shape conduct, priorities, relationships, worship, and mission.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Some people confuse knowledge with maturity. They may know doctrine, attend church, or speak Christian language while resisting clear obedience. Scripture does not honor hearing that refuses to act.

This doctrine helps believers connect faith with daily life. Obedience is not legalism when it flows from love for Christ and dependence on grace.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask where God’s Word is calling for actual obedience. Do not delay repentance or hide behind knowledge. Take the next faithful step, trusting Christ’s grace to forgive, strengthen, and lead you in a life that honors Him.
